animations.name: parado
animations.action: guarded idle breathing: ready; inhale chest lifts; shoulders rise; exhale bent front knee; settle hair; recover ready

animations.name: andar

animations.name: andar-tras
animations.action: backward WALK with guard maintained: rear toe reaches back; load rear leg; front foot slides; other rear step; transfer weight; finish a cautious backward step. Never turn away

animations.name: correr
animations.action: forward RUN cycle: rear-leg push; long airborne stride; front-foot landing; knee compresses; opposite-leg drive; opposite airborne stride. Lean forward and hold whip handle safely

animations.name: agachar

animations.name: pulo

animations.name: recuo

animations.name: escape-agarrao

animations.name: defesa-em-pe

animations.name: defesa-agachado

animations.name: defesa-no-ar

animations.name: dano-alto

animations.name: dano-baixo
